title: SEC Charges Two Companies in $130 Million Crypto Trading Scheme
summary: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Charges Two Companies in $130 Million Crypto Trading Scheme The SEC has charged two companies with defrauding investors of over $130 million through a crypto Ponzi-like scheme. This post SEC Charges Two Companies in $130 Million Crypto Trading Scheme first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
